description: Shows your GitHub Copilot quota in the status bar, with a daily budget, pace forecast, threshold warnings and tips for making it last.
cfg.refreshIntervalMinutes: How often the quota is refreshed, in minutes. The quota is also refreshed when the window regains focus.
cfg.display:
What the status bar item shows.

- `remaining`: requests/credits left
- `used`: requests/credits used so far
- `percent`: percentage used
- `dailyBudget`: what you can spend per day until the reset
cfg.alignment: Which side of the status bar the item appears on. Requires a window reload to take effect.
cfg.thresholds: Usage percentages at which a warning is shown, e.g. `[50, 75, 90, 100]`. Each threshold is reported once per billing cycle.
cfg.paceWarning: Warn once when, at your current pace, the quota will run out before it resets.
cfg.warningsEnabled: Show notifications for thresholds and pace warnings. The status bar keeps updating when this is off.
cfg.countWeekends: Count Saturdays and Sundays as budget days. When off, the daily budget is spread over weekdays only, so each workday gets a larger share.
cfg.reserve: Amount of the quota (in requests or credits) to hold back as a reserve. It is subtracted from the remaining quota before the daily budget is calculated. `0` disables the reserve.
cfg.tipsEnabled: Show a saving tip in the status bar tooltip.
walk.title: Get started with Copilot Contingent Watcher
walk.description: Keep an eye on your Copilot quota and make it last until the reset.
walk.signIn.title: Sign in with GitHub
walk.signIn.description:
The extension reuses your existing VS Code GitHub sign-in. No token is stored.
[Sign in](command:contingentWatcher.signIn)
walk.statusBar.title: Read the status bar
walk.statusBar.description:
Your quota, daily budget and pace at a glance. Click the item for details.
[Show details](command:contingentWatcher.showDetails)
walk.save.title: Make your quota last
walk.save.description:
Practical habits that save requests without slowing you down.
[Show saving tips](command:contingentWatcher.showTips)
walk.configure.title: Make it yours
walk.configure.description:
Choose the display mode, warning thresholds, weekends and a reserve.
[Open settings](command:contingentWatcher.openSettings)
cfg.authProvider: Which sign-in to use. `auto` follows Copilot (`github.copilot.advanced.authProvider`) and `github-enterprise.uri` and falls back to the other provider.
cfg.authProvider.github: github.com account (including Copilot Business/Enterprise seats on github.com)
cfg.authProvider.enterprise: GitHub Enterprise (GHE.com or GitHub Enterprise Server, uses `github-enterprise.uri`)
cfg.apiUrl: Optional API base URL override, e.g. `https://api.acme.ghe.com`. Leave empty to derive it automatically.
cfg.accentColor: Accent colour of the dashboard gauge: `auto` (theme), a preset (`teal`, `violet`, `blue`, `green`, `orange`, `pink`) or a hex colour like `#ff8800`.
cfg.statusBarIcon: Icon style in the status bar. The icon fills down as your allowance is used.
cfg.statusBarColor: Text/icon colour of the status bar item: `auto` (theme), a preset or a hex colour. With a custom colour the item always shows just your chosen display in that colour (no warning background).
cfg.surplusHint: In the last week of the month, tell me if part of my allowance will likely expire unused ("use it or lose it").
cfg.activity: Record active editor time and usage per git branch for the history view. Stays on this computer.
cfg.preferredModels: Model families `@sparsam` may use, in order of preference (prefix match). Pick models that are included in your plan (0x multiplier). If none is available, `@sparsam` does not answer rather than falling back to a premium model.
chat.description: Answers with an included model, no premium requests
chat.btw: Quick side question with a free model; your main chat stays untouched
cfg.btwIncludeChat: Use a snapshot of your most recent Copilot chat (read from VS Code's local chat storage) as context for btw side questions. When off, only the editor is used.
